title: AOT 編譯
content:
The AOT (Ahead-of-Time) compilation process occurs during the engine's boot sequence. Instead of matching routes dynamically at runtime, Photon pre-calculates the optimal execution path.

The Compilation Pipeline

When you start your server, Photon analyzes your route tree and converts static paths into a high-speed Hash Map. This guarantees O(1) time complexity for static route dispatching, regardless of how many thousands of routes you have.
